Easter · 26 to 29 March 2027 · QLD school holidays to 11 April

Jonathan is turning 40.
Come celebrate.
Caesars at 7.

A long weekend away with the people Jonathan loves. Twelve at most, a pool, room to breathe, and somewhere worth the drive. Houses are ranked by the Caesar Index, defined below. Every price below was pulled live from the booking platforms on 16 August 2026 for 12 guests, fees included. Easter weekend is the one window that works for both QLD and NSW school families: QLD holidays run 26 March to 11 April 2027, NSW autumn holidays start 12 April, so the long weekend itself is the only overlap. That is why the shortlist centres on 26 to 29 March.

The Hacienda · Nashua, Byron hinterland

Things to do

Real Byron-area operators for the weekend. Prices are indicative, Easter books out early, so hold dates before Christmas. Anything with a person attached needs an enquiry, links go to each operator.

Drinks · someone to pour

Cocktail bartender

BYO is the move for a weekend like this: you buy the alcohol yourself (Dan Murphy's or a wholesaler, far cheaper than any bar's markup) and hire staff who bring the bar, glassware, ice, garnishes and mixers and pour all night. Byron BYO operators:

Torley's Bar Services - region's highest-rated, 200+ five-star reviews, explicit BYO cocktail and BYO beverage packages. Ph 0422 542 336.
Barmen For Hire - hire bartenders by the hour (BYO) or as a full package, plus a 60-90 min mixology masterclass option.
Flossy Byron Bay - BYO mobile bar, you supply alcohol, they do the rest; fun fairy-floss cocktail gimmick for the party.
Fern (via Wedlockers) - eco pop-up bar for Byron/Northern NSW, $300-450/hr, min 2 hours, includes 2 staff, glassware and styling.

Ballpark for BYO: roughly $300-450/hr for two staff, minimum two hours, plus whatever you spend on the grog.
Torley's BYO Barmen Flossy
Vote
Kids

Kids entertainer

Byron Bay Children's Parties (Byron4Kids) send entertainers, face painters, balloon benders, a circus silly show, even stilt walkers, to the house across Byron and Ballina shires. Shorty Brown is the local favourite, bubbles, magic, slapstick, high energy, buys the adults a clean window. Kidzklub covers the Bangalow hinterland with face painting, giant games and craft. Ballpark: face painter $140 to $500, entertainer around $400 to $900 for a two-hour set.
Byron4Kids Kidzklub
Vote
Kids · animals

Mobile petting farm

A trailer full of friendly animals set up on the lawn: lambs, goats, chickens, rabbits, guinea pigs, the works. Hands-on, wide age range, and genuinely a hit. Animals on the Move and Old Macdonald's Travelling Farms both service the Northern Rivers and come to you. Ballpark: roughly $300 to $500 for a set visit.
Animals on the Move Old Macdonald's
Vote
Kids · ponies

Pony rides

Hand-led pony rides on the property, or the nearby Zephyr Horses ranch does pony rides for ages 3 to 8 and beach trail rides for older kids (10+). Byron4Kids can also arrange pony rides to the house. A gentle, memorable one for the littler ones.
Zephyr Horses Byron4Kids
Vote
Kids · bounce

Jumping castle

The reliable all-day energy-burner. Local hire across Byron and Ballina shires via Byron4Kids and Northern Rivers party-hire operators. Set it up on the lawn Saturday and the kids disappear into it for hours. Ballpark: $200 to $400 for a weekend hire depending on size.
Byron4Kids
Vote
Kids · make it

Craft & art workshop

Kidzklub and Home Makers Club run hands-on craft and art sessions, sand art, scratch art, clay, painting, that keep a range of ages absorbed and quiet for a good hour. Low-key, low-cost, and easy to run in a shaded corner while the adults have a break.
Kidzklub Byron4Kids
Vote
Kids · dance

Kids disco

Byron4Kids run a kids disco setup: DJ, lights, lasers, speakers, smoke machine, epic tunes. Burns off the sugar before dinner and the little ones love it. Slots neatly into the late afternoon before the adult evening kicks off.
Byron4Kids
Vote
Kids · day out

Byron Wildlife Sanctuary

Not a hire, an escape valve. The Byron Bay Wildlife Sanctuary (old Macadamia Castle) has a mini-golf course, water park, kids play area and animal encounters (snakes, lizards, owls, sugar gliders). Half a day out with the kids if the house needs a reset, about 20 min from Nashua.
Wildlife Sanctuary
Vote
Recovery · Sunday

Poolside massage

The plan: book therapists for a 4-hour block and let them rotate. You pay for the time, not per person. One therapist doing 30-min sessions gets through ~8 people in 4 hours; two therapists working side by side clear the whole group comfortably. Everyone else is in the pool waiting their turn.

Byron operators that do group bookings and cover Bangalow / Federal (next to Nashua):
Byron Bay Mobile Massage - coordinates multiple therapists for group bookings, call ahead.
Beachside Yoga & Massage - mobile to Bangalow/Federal, group discounts, cash or transfer.
Byron Health Studio - premium mobile, explicitly does curated group bodywork for private events.
Blys - app-based, book multiple therapists to an address for a set time.

Ballpark: roughly $120-160 per therapist per hour, so a 4-hour two-therapist block is about $960-1,280. Sunday morning after the big night is the most-appreciated booking of the weekend.
Byron Mobile Byron Health Blys
Vote
Reset · morning

Breathwork

Breathwork Byron (Dan and Sara) run private sessions and group circles, conscious connected breathing, no experience needed, they can come to a group. Boundless Breathing pair guided breath with an ice bath / cold plunge for private groups, the resilience-and-recovery angle, good for the hardier crew. Both suit a hinterland deck or lawn. Ballpark: private group session a few hundred dollars depending on numbers and length.
Breathwork Byron Boundless
Vote
The Byron special

Sound journey & cacao

The legal end of the "expanded states" spectrum, and Byron does it better than anywhere. A facilitator brings gongs, singing bowls and a ceremonial cacao for a guided sound journey on the deck, deep relaxation without anything that gets anyone arrested or scares the kids. Rise Temple and the OM Byron network run these as private group sessions. Ballpark: $250 to $600 for the group.
Rise Temple OM Byron
Vote
Named facilitators · comes to you

Sound Healing Australia

Seriya and Matty bring a full private-group sound healing to the house, published rate $990 + GST for two facilitators in the Byron Bay area (small travel fee for Ballina / Tweed). They also offer cacao ceremonies, fire ceremonies, men's and women's circles and drumming as add-ons. The most straightforward "book it, they arrive, they run it" option on this list.
Book / quote
Vote
Named facilitators

Cacao & breath, by name

Daniele Manodritto runs the well-known Byron cacao-and-sound journey with instruments from around the world, bookable privately via Byron Bay Experience. Kristy "Krissy" Ferrari is a renowned local breathwork-and-cacao facilitator (Heartwood Farm hinterland sessions). Byron Bay Experience acts as a concierge that will pull any of these together for a private group and handle the booking.
Daniele Krissy
Vote
Where locals actually look

Find your own

The facilitator scene shifts constantly, so the reliable way in is the local channels: The Wellness Centre Byron Bay, the yoga studios in the Byron Arts and Industry Estate, and the Facebook groups Byron Bay Events and Healing Arts Byron where most ceremonies are advertised. Community circles run $60 to $100pp, private or longer ones $120 to $150pp.
The guide
Once the kids are down

Axe throwing

Adults only (18+), and exactly the right amount of stupid for a 40th. Mobile and venue axe-throwing operates across the Northern Rivers, targets, coaching, the lot. Ballpark: around $45 a head. Best run as an afternoon or early-evening block before dinner.
Find operators
Vote
Grazing

Feed the crowd

A grazing table or box on the Saturday arrival feeds 12 adults plus kids for hours with no cooking. Doubles as lunch and afternoon picking, which frees the budget for a chef or spit at the birthday dinner. Ballpark: $20 to $35 a head, so $300 to $450 for the group.
Find caterers
Vote
The big dinner

Private chef

The single best spend for the birthday night: a chef cooks a feast at the house and cleans up. Byron Bay Chef (Lucas Becker) does exactly this at holiday houses, South/Central American and Mediterranean menus, glowing reviews for milestone birthdays. Terra Catering (Bruno) for rustic Italian banquets. Made by Maria for personalised party menus. Ballpark: roughly $100 to $180 a head.
Byron Bay Chef Terra
Vote
Feed the crowd · easy

Spit roast

Carve It Up Catering do gourmet spit roasts using Byron Bay Pork Co (voted best pork on the east coast), premium beef, Tasmanian lamb and chicken, plus burger, taco and pizza bars, 20+ years in the region. Emma Dennett (Personal Chef Byron Bay) sources lamb spit-roasts for birthdays with veg, salads, breads and dips, and gets called well-priced. Ballpark: $25 to $45 a head. Feeds a big daytime crowd easily.
Carve It Up Emma Dennett
Vote
Feed the crowd · fun

Wood-fired pizza

Byron Homemade Pizza run a mobile gas-grill setup and have worked hinterland properties in Bangalow and Newrybar specifically. All-you-can-eat gourmet pizza from $40 a head, grazing and dessert add-ons, min spend $2,000 on weekends. Kids love it, and it scales to the bigger daytime numbers.
Byron Homemade Pizza
Vote
Grazing · arrival

Grazing table

EatDrink Catering (Ballina to Byron) do stunning grazing tables, shared platters, fork food and food stations, scalable to whatever your daytime peak is. A grazing spread on arrival feeds everyone for hours with no cooking and doubles as lunch. Ballpark: $20 to $35 a head.
EatDrink

The night

Music & late dancing

A solo acoustic act or duo for the Saturday evening suits a house with kids better than anything louder. For the late session, silent disco headsets let the diehards dance without waking the little ones or annoying the valley. Ballpark: musician $400 to $800, silent disco headset hire $200 to $400 for the weekend.

For friends not sleeping at the house

Stay nearby

The Hacienda sleeps 12 and that's a firm cap. If you want to come, book your own bed close by and roll over for the day: pool, food, party, then back to your place to sleep. Cluster around Bangalow (10 min) so there's a town with cafes and restaurants for the morning-after. Daytime party guests are welcome, Jono is clearing the numbers and event fee with the host, so let him know if you're coming.

Closest · same village

Nashua & Newrybar

Minutes from The Hacienda. The Cottage (renovated 1890s coach house on a 120-acre farm) and Blackwood (2BR timber tiny home, walk to Newrybar village and Harvest). A handful of eco villas and farm studios around here too. Best for a couple or small family who want to be right next door.
Search Newrybar
Most beds · 10 min

Bangalow

The overflow HQ. Walkable town, cafes and restaurants, and the most places to stay. Carinya (six modern villas, cluster a few families in one spot), Bangalow Guesthouse (heritage rooms, three cottages and an apartment on one property), and plenty of houses and cottages. Point most people here.
Search Bangalow
Quieter · 10-15 min

Federal & Possum Creek

More hinterland cottages and farm stays if the closer towns fill up. A little more spread out and rural, good for anyone after peace and a view rather than walking distance to a cafe.
Search Federal
Beach · 15-20 min

Lennox Head & Ballina

If some of the crew would rather wake up near the beach than in the hills, Lennox and Ballina are a short drive and have motels, apartments and houses across all budgets. Easy run over to Nashua for the day.
Search Lennox

How a house made this list

Every property below survived five gates, applied in order. Fail one, gone.

Gate 1

Available

Live-searched on Airbnb and Stayz on 16 August 2026 with the actual dates loaded, Fri 26 to Mon 29 March 2027. Dated searches only return bookable houses, so presence is proof. Easter Saturday is the most contested booking night of the year; most of Queensland already failed this gate.
Gate 2

Fits 12

Three families, twelve people at most. Under 10 beds needed a good excuse; over 20 meant paying for air.
Gate 3

Pool

Non-negotiable and filtered at source. The pool is load-bearing infrastructure for the Caesar programme, detailed below.
Gate 4

Two hours of Brisbane

Measured from Ferny Hills. One exception was granted five extra minutes for being in the Byron hinterland and cheap.
Gate 5

Verified

Prices captured live including taxes and fees, cancellation terms read from the listing, and all 56 photos checked against the source before embedding. One dead image was caught and replaced. Nothing here is decorative guesswork.
The instrument that ranks them

The Caesar Index

The critical measure. It scores one thing: can the host of this event drink a Caesar by the pool at 7am in the nood without consequence. One celery stick per condition met. Cameras were ruled an acceptable audience and do not affect the score.

No sightlines. The pool is not overlooked by a road, a public track, or a neighbouring deck.
No residents. No host, caretaker or occupied dwelling on the property beyond your own party.
Genuine isolation. The nearest uninvolved human is a paddock, a valley or a national park away. Only Eighteen Mile holds all three.
